rules: Every record carries the URL it came from. Counts are as of that source's snapshot and can differ between trackers.
Records marked 'supplied' come from the pre-existing research pack and were NOT re-verified here.
Different competitions are never merged into one line; each competition is its own record.
Nothing here is a Stage 3 pressure estimate. Pressure scores remain N/A where no usable Stage 3 sample exists.
